definitions: A type of ancient chariot that is pulled by a single animal or a pair of animals, characterized by having a central shaft extending forward from the body of the chariot to which the animal(s) are yoked.
A chariot designed with a prominent central pole or shaft for harnessing, as opposed to other designs.
examples: The archaeological dig unearthed a well-preserved shaft chariot.
Depictions of the shaft chariot are common in ancient art.
The warrior rode into battle in his shaft chariot.
